Method of Attack: Exploitation of symbolic link (symlink) following vulnerability
Bypassing file system restrictions to access unauthorized files
Tricking users into uploading symlink files to access sensitive data
Attack Vector: User interaction with symlinks via drag-and-drop onto file input elements
Uploading symlink files to malicious websites
Indicators of Compromise: Bogus websites prompting users to upload recovery keys
ZIP archive files containing symlinks to sensitive files
